_meta.comment: Pre-farm guides for featured/upcoming banners. Material names and quantities obey the 2-source rule (see SOURCES.md 'Pre-farm guides' section); editorial farming priorities are labeled as such. Material tables render from data/characters/<slug>.json (source of truth) — this file holds guide framing only.

guides.description: Pre-farm checklist for Suoming (WuWa 3.7 Phase 2, banner opens ~Oct 22, 2026): every ascension and forte material with verified quantities and farming routes.
farmNow: LF / MF / HF / FF Howler Core
Broken / Monowing / Polywing / Layered Wing Polarizer

sources.label: Game8 — Suoming Release Date and Attribute (materials tables)

tips.body: Remnant of the Wheel (×26) comes from a new 3.7 weekly boss, capped at 3 claims per week account-wide — so a fully maxed forte tree takes roughly 9 weeks from launch even if you start day one. She shares this drop with Hsin: if you're building both, plan for the claims to stretch across ~18 weeks, or pick one to max first.
tips.heading: Start with the weekly-boss math

tips.body: Fallen Sanctum (Forgery Challenge, Etching Plains) drops all four Wing Polarizer tiers in one place. Run the highest difficulty your Union Level allows — higher tiers weight drops toward Polywing and Layered Wing, which are the ones you'll run short on (55 and 67 needed).
tips.heading: Farm polarizers first — they're live now

tips.body: Early pre-farm lists guessed Autopuppet Kernel because she's a Mengzhou Resonator, but her farming card shows Howler Cores — the oldest core family in the game. You need 29 LF, 40 MF, 52 HF and 61 FF across ascension and forte. Trade up 3-to-1 at the Synthesizer rather than over-farming low tiers.
tips.heading: Howler Cores, not Autopuppet Kernels

tips.body: Forged Empyrean's Sigh (×46) drops from Calamity Effigy at Verdant Court, on the western side of Xuanfang Hold. It unlocks through Chapter 4 Act III (the quest 'Song of the Heart Sword') — or open the Guidebook and use Boss Challenge early access if your story progress is behind. Don't start pre-farming the day the banner drops without the boss unlocked.
tips.heading: Unlock the boss before Oct 22

tips.body: Her local specialty (×60) lives in the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou — 48 per sweep from 6 clusters of red-aura tree remains (NW beacon riverside → SE lakeshore → NE shore → Heartscape Labyrinth → Repair Workshop arena → N of Heart of Bloom), plus 15 at the Huaxu Apothecary for 45,000 Shell Credits. Specialties respawn daily, so one sweep plus the shop covers all 60.
tips.heading: Miasmic Branch arrives on patch day

tips.body: 170,000 for ascension plus 2,030,000 for the full forte tree. (Add ~330,000 more if you're also leveling her signature sword Unspoken Rue.) Start banking credits now — this is the easiest thing to fall behind on.
tips.heading: Budget 2.2M Shell Credits

guides.description: Pre-farm checklist for Lynae (WuWa 3.7 Phase 2, banner opens ~Oct 22, 2026): every ascension and forte material with verified quantities and farming routes.
farmNow: LF / MF / HF / FF Exoswarm Core

sources.label: sportskeeda — Rimewisp locations and farming guide

tips.body: Lynae debuted in 3.0, so nothing on her list is time-gated — you can have her fully pre-farmed before the Phase 2 banner opens. The only pacing constraint is the weekly boss.
tips.heading: Everything is farmable right now

tips.body: Dreamless Feather (×26) comes from the weekly boss Dreamless, capped at 3 claims per week. Start claiming now if you haven't — 26 drops takes about 9 weeks of full claims.
tips.heading: Weekly boss is the bottleneck

tips.body: Suncoveter's Reach (×46) drops from the Hyvatia world boss at Starward Riseway, Lahai-Roi — the same boss Lucilla needs for her ascension. If you're pulling both Phase 2 5-stars, farm this boss for both lists at once.
tips.heading: Hyvatia covers two characters

tips.body: You need 60 Rimewisps. Sweep the Lahai-Roi overworld (~40 nodes across Etching Plains and the area outside the Hyvatia arena near Starward Riseway), then buy 15 per week from the N.A.N.A. Resonator Nursing Unit for 3,000 Shell Credits each. One sweep plus one shop restock nearly covers it.
tips.heading: Rimewisp routes

tips.body: Incomplete / Aftertune / Remnant / Reverb Combustors (25 / 28 / 55 / 67) drop from the Forgery Challenge in Lahai-Roi. Run the highest difficulty available for better odds at Remnant and Reverb tiers.
tips.heading: Combustors come from Lahai-Roi forgeries

tips.body: Lucilla debuted in 3.4, so her whole list is available today. The only pacing constraint is the weekly boss drop.
tips.heading: Everything is farmable right now

tips.body: We Who Question (×26) drops from the Denia weekly challenge (Seed of Illusory Origin, Dimmr Plains), capped at 3 claims per week — about 9 weeks of full claims to max the forte tree.
tips.heading: Weekly boss is the bottleneck

tips.body: Spliced / Broken / Solidified / Melodic Strings (25 / 28 / 55 / 67) drop from the Lesson in Sunset Forgery Challenge in Etching Plains — the same challenge Rectifier users like Hsin farm. Run the highest difficulty for Solidified and Melodic tiers.
tips.heading: Strings come from Lesson in Sunset

tips.body: All four Mech Core tiers (4 / 12 / 12 / 4 ascension, 25 / 28 / 40 / 57 forte) drop from mechanical Clamorling Tacet Discords in Lahai-Roi — Geospider S4, Sabercat Reaver, Spacetrek Explorer, Twin Nova. (A few guides mislabel these as 'Exoswarm' cores; the correct drop is Mech Cores.)
tips.heading: Mech Cores from Clamorling TDs

tips.body: Suncoveter's Reach (×46) drops from the Hyvatia world boss at Starward Riseway, Lahai-Roi — the same boss Lynae needs. Farm both lists together if you're pulling both.
tips.heading: Share the Hyvatia grind with Lynae

tips.body: Her local specialty (×60) is gathered in the Lahai-Roi overworld with no shop shortcut listed — plan two or three sweep runs, since specialties respawn daily.
tips.heading: Forget-Me-Not is pure overworld
